_readme: Schema for the Contributors Index. The silicon-index-contributors.github.io repo (dev branch) has no Pages deployment or record templates yet, so this file defines the interim shape produced by this portal's admin check-up flow (see admin.html + contributions.js#getContributorsIndex). A record is added here only after an admin approves a submission in the Admin Panel — pending/rejected submissions never appear. Swap this static seed for a live feed from silicon-index-backend-api once Phase 5 lands.

fields.contributor: Display name, or "Anonymous" for unauthenticated submissions. Never a real name/email/PII.
fields.isAnonymous: true if the submission was made without a signed-in account.
fields.trust: "Trusted Contributor" for signed-in approved contributors, "Anonymous Contribution" for anonymous approved ones.
fields.approvedCount: Number of approved submissions attributed to this contributor.
fields.lastApprovedAt: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent admin approval.
